title: From Facts to Conclusions : Integrating Deductive Reasoning in Retrieval-Augmented LLMs
authors: Shubham Mishra; Samyek Jain; Gorang Mehrishi; Shiv Tiwari; Harsh Sharma; Pratik Narang; Dhruv Kumar
why_relevant: Proposes a reasoning-trace-augmented RAG framework explicitly for handling conflicting/outdated evidence with justified refusals, and introduces a Conflict-Aware Trust Score (CATS) evaluation metric covering groundedness, refusal, and conflict-behavior alignment.
why_not_or_caveat: Small 539-query dataset and reliance on LLM-as-judge limits generality.
